notes.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Update Released
notes.notes:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Patch 1.02:

This patch fixes the bug in online co-op play where for people playing Totec, Lara keeps shooting in the same direction.

notes.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light Update Released
notes.notes:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light version 1.01

Included in the patch:

  • Online Co-Op play added! Play online with your friends as either Lara or Totec.
  • Improvements to in-game mouse/keyboard and gamepad controls
  • Improvements to overall performance and stability
  • Additional audio and visual polish

notes.title: New Release - Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light
notes.notes:
Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light is now available on Steam.

Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light is an action/adventure game featuring Lara Croft. This brand extension combines the hallmarks of the Tomb Raider franchise including exploration & discovery, platforming, and puzzle solving combined with character progression, fun fast-paced combat, and elements of human cooperation and competition.
